title: Sticky Torches
description: Adds throwable sticky torches to Minecraft.
body:
# What are Sticky Torches?
Sticky Torches is a mod that adds throwable **sticky torches** to Minecraft! 

![galleryflat](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b4c0d1e82ba8461760832111aa6d6e01f7abd95d_0.webp)

## Are they balanced?
#### Great power comes at a great cost.
- You can craft a **sticky torch** using a regular torch and a slimeball.
- Provides value and utility to slimeballs in the early game.
- One slimeball gets you one **sticky torch** use them wisely.

## Recipes
![Recipes](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f36f62f0e6796ecc7b3f5f790bef41a41ce2bb30.gif)

## Features
- Sticks to every surface a normal torch does, and more! (...the ceiling)
- Green color helps you tell them apart, go pick up that sticky torch and throw it again!

## Known Issues
- Occasionally, throwing a torch at an angle where it hits two blocks at once will cause a second "ghost" sticky torch to appear, that requires placing a block to remove.

## Future plans
- Implement for older versions of minecraft
- Implement for neoforge
- Mod options to personalize your experience
